Historical analysis shows: Every peaceful movement that gets **{{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} active support** succeeds.

- $8 \text{ billion humans} \times 3.5\% = 280 \text{ million}$
- The public target is a verified majority of humanity voting YES on a [1% treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd)
- The 3.5% benchmark is the historical lower bound where pressure starts becoming hard to ignore
- That's achievable. Here's how.

## The Message That Spreads

### What Doesn't Go Viral

- "Please donate to clinical trials" (boring)
- "Policy proposal for healthcare reform" (sleep-inducing)
- "Consider supporting this initiative" (ignored)

### What Does Go Viral

![You're really good at destroying things and really bad at fixing things. The sweet spot is when destroying and fixing both make money. That's the intersection you've been looking for.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-what-does-go-viral-bw-academic.jpg)

- "Humanity has 13,000 nukes [@world-warheads] but no cure for your kid's cancer" (rage-inducing)
- "You're spending {{< var global_military_spending_per_capita_annual >}}/year on killing people, $8/year on curing them" (shocking)
- "{{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} investment returns while saving humanity" (greed + altruism)

## The Viral Formula

$$
\text{Emotion} + \text{Personal Stake} + \text{Shareability} = \text{Viral}
$$

### Emotional Triggers

- **Anger**: "FDA delays kill more than the drugs [@gieringer-drug-lag-estimate]"
- **Fear**: "You'll die of disease, not war"
- **Hope**: "You could cure this in 10 years"
- **Greed**: "{{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} forever"

### Personal Stake

- "Your tax dollars: {{< var global_military_spending_per_capita_annual >}} to war, $8 to cures"
- "Your mom dies while bureaucrats meet"
- "Your kid's rare disease: $0 funding"

### Shareability

- One-sentence summary
- Shocking statistic
- Clear call to action

## The Content Ladder

### Level 1: The Hook (3 seconds)

![If this bar represents weapons spending, then medical research is this dot. You might need to zoom in. Keep zooming. Little more. There it is.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-level-1-the-hook-3-seconds-bw-academic.jpg)

**"Humanity spends {{< var military_to_government_clinical_trials_spending_ratio >}}X more on weapons than testing which medicines work"**

- Simple
- Shocking
- Shareable

### Level 2: The Emotion (30 seconds)

**"While you read this, 50 people died of preventable disease. We have the money to cure them. Humans spend it on weapons instead."**

### Level 3: The Solution (3 minutes)

![Move 1 percent of your war budget to medicine. Test drugs 44 times cheaper. Cure major diseases in 19 years. The math is simple. The politics is where things get complicated.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-level-3-the-solution-3-minutes-bw-academic.jpg)

**"A 1% treaty: Redirect 1% of military spending to pragmatic clinical trials. Fund trials that are {{< var dfda_trial_cost_reduction_factor >}} cheaper. Cure major diseases in 19 years. Everyone wins."**

### Level 4: The Action (immediate)

**"Vote YES. Buy bonds. Share this."**

![Hook them in 3 seconds, radicalize them in 30, convert them in 3 minutes, and get them to give you money before they realize what happened. It's not manipulation if you're curing cancer.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-viral-engagement-pyramid-bw-academic.jpg)

## Platform-Specific Strategies

### Twitter/X

- Death counter bots: "147 died while you scrolled"
- Spending comparisons: Daily updates
- Quote politicians saying they care
- Then show their votes for war budgets

### TikTok/Reels

- 15-second videos: "Guess what your taxes buy"
- Before/after: Dystopia 2050 vs Wishonia 2050
- Doctors explaining why they can't cure you
- Patients explaining why they're dying

### YouTube

- Long-form explainers
- Interviews with doctors
- Financial breakdown of VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds
- Debate: "Is curing disease profitable?"

### Reddit

- AMAs with researchers
- Data visualizations
- "ELI5: Why doesn't my rare disease have treatment?"
- Financial analysis of bonds

## The Referral System

### Individual Incentives

- Share with 10 people → Entered in bond lottery
- Get 100 votes → Free VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bond
- Reach influencer status → Speaking opportunities

### Influencer Incentives

- 1M views discussing treaty → $10K in bonds
- Convert followers to voters → Bonus VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bond allocation
- Top promoter → Named institute

### Corporate Incentives

- Companies that promote treaty → Tax benefits
- Employee participation programs → Matching bonds
- PR value: "We're saving humanity"

## The Meme Arsenal

### Economic Memes

- "Raytheon CEO salary vs rare disease research funding"
- "Cost of one F-35 [@f35-cost-vs-rare-disease-research] = ~160 Oxford-style trials"
- "We have money for 13,000 nukes but not your insulin"

![One F-35 fighter jet costs the same as 160 clinical trials. The jet can bomb 160 targets. The trials can cure 160 diseases. Both are technically 160 things, if you're keeping score.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-economic-memes-bw-academic.jpg)

### Emotional Memes

- "Why is my kid dying while governments build Skynet?"
- "Imagine if humanity spent weapons money on cures"
- "The government chose missiles over your mom"

### Comparison Memes

- "Military budget breaks your screen / Clinical trials barely visible"
- "Days to approve weapons: 1 / Days to approve cancer cure: 6,205 [@research-to-practice-gap]"

## The Influencer Strategy

### Target Categories

![Tech billionaires want immortality, parents want their kids to live, old people want more time, and humanitarians want everyone to stop dying. Four different flavors of not wanting to die. Pick your audience.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-target-categories-bw-academic.jpg)

**Health/Wellness** (100M+ followers combined):

- They already care about health
- Their audience is health-conscious
- Natural fit for cure advocacy

**Finance/Investment** (50M+ followers):

- "{{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns is compelling content"
- Financial analysis is their specialty
- Greed motivates sharing

**Gaming/Tech** (200M+ followers):

- Young, internet-native
- Understand decentralization
- Hate bureaucracy

**Political** (150M+ followers):

- Both left and right can support
- Bipartisan message
- Career-making position

### The Pitch to Influencers

"Make one video about a 1% treaty:

- Engineered to go viral (emotional + controversial)
- Positions you as visionary
- Potential to save millions of lives
- Plus: Offer them bonds"

![How to pitch influencers: Promise them virality, clout, moral superiority, and money. If you offer all four simultaneously, they'll promote anything. Even curing disease.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-the-pitch-to-influencers-bw-academic.jpg)

## The Data That Spreads

### Daily Updates

- "Today's death toll: 150,000 [@who-daily-deaths]"
- "Total spent on war today: ~$7.4 billion"
- "Total spent on cures today: $186 million [@global-gov-med-research-spending]"
- "Ratio: Still insane"

![Every day, humanity spends 7.5 billion on weapons and 12 million on finding cures. That's 625 times more on killing than healing. Your species chose this ratio voluntarily.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-daily-updates-bw-academic.jpg)

### Personal Calculators

- "Your tax contribution to war: {{< var global_military_spending_per_capita_annual >}}"
- "Your tax contribution to cures: $8"
- "If you redirected 1%: Lives saved: 0.003"

### Comparison Tools

- "Your city's military spending could fund X trials"
- "Your state's military budget could cure Y diseases"

## The Controversy Strategy

### Hot Takes That Generate Engagement

- "FDA has killed more Americans than terrorists [@gieringer-drug-lag-estimate]"
- "NIH is a {{< var nih_annual_budget >}} jobs program, not a cure program"
- "Your vote doesn't matter (Princeton proved it)"
- "We're building Skynet while your mom dies"

### Expected Pushback (and Responses)

**"You're oversimplifying!"**

→ "And you're overcomplicating. People are dying."

**"This will never work!"**

→ "Oxford RECOVERY trial [@recovery-trial-summary-quote] already proved it works."

**"The military needs its budget!"**

→ "The treaty takes 1%. Nations keep {{< var defense_sector_retention_pct >}}. Relax."

## The Metrics

### Viral Success Indicators

- **Phase 1** (Month 1-3): 10M aware
- **Phase 2** (Month 4-6): 100M engaged
- **Phase 3** (Month 7-12): 280M committed

### Conversion Funnel

- **Aware**: Saw the message
- **Engaged**: Clicked, read, watched
- **Shared**: Told others
- **Committed**: Voted YES or bought bonds

### Target Ratios

- 1 billion aware → 500M engaged → 280M committed
- Share rate: 50% (if content is good)
- Commitment rate: 56% (if message resonates)

![Get 8 billion people aware, convert 280 million to supporters, convince 160 countries to sign a treaty. It's just a marketing funnel, except instead of selling shoes, you're selling not dying horribly from preventable diseases.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-voter-conversion-funnel-bw-academic.jpg)

## The Timeline (Years 1-2 of the Roadmap)

This viral marketing campaign builds awareness and support during the first 18 months, preparing for the treaty push in months 19-36. 

![Three years to save humanity, divided neatly into 'make it trendy' and 'make it law.' Like planning a wedding, but for not dying.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-the-timeline-years-1-2-of-the-roadmap-bw-academic.jpg)

### Months 1-6: Foundation & Launch

- Launch website and core content
- Recruit first 100,000 advocates
- Influencer partnerships begin
- Viral campaigns and media coverage

### Months 7-12: Acceleration

- Reach 100M people aware
- Scale referral program
- Political pressure begins building

### Months 13-18: Critical Mass

- 280M voters committed
- Media saturation
- Politicians feel pressure
- Ready for treaty push (months 19-36)
- Mainstream coverage

## The Strategy

Don't ask people to donate.
Don't ask people to change.
Ask them to **vote for not dying**.

![Turns out people will click on 'not dying' but ignore 'please donate.' Humanity finally discovers its one shared value.](/assets/images/viral-marketing/viral-marketing-section-the-strategy-bw-academic.jpg)

That's the easiest thing to make go viral.

Because everyone, eventually, doesn't want to die.
